control_definitions.pairs: Optimize two chairs per compound with conformer checks retaining all three n-butyl chains.
control_definitions.fixed_distance_torsion: For each compound use the axial geometry, select the lowest-ID Sn-bound butyl carbon. Define torsion C_beta-C_alpha-Sn-C_ring. Keep Sn-C_alpha at its axial equilibrium value and calculate at the baseline torsion plus +/-30 degrees, relaxing other coordinates under constraints.
control_definitions.fixed_torsion_distance: Hold the same baseline torsion and calculate Sn-C_alpha at equilibrium +/-0.03 angstrom. These imposed displacements are interventions, not source data or minima.
control_definitions.orbital_analysis: Quantify donor/acceptor localization or mixing for the same mapped bonds. NBO is allowed only if callable; a replacement must define and validate its metric instead of labelling it NBO E2.

observable_definition: Signed J_total(119Sn,13C)=J_FC+J_SD+J_PSO+J_DSO in Hz, for each mapped Sn–C_butyl bond; arithmetic mean over three bonds. Report raw unscaled J and the exact Hamiltonian/basis. An empirical scale or a relativistic change cannot share an uncalibrated narrow tolerance.
optional_not_scored: All original carbohydrate substrates, additional sulfur series and proprietary NBO upgrades are optional.
source_note: Molecular identities, benchmark-defined starts and explicitly labelled measured observations are authorized inputs. Graph provenance identifies chemical identity only; state labels, optimized added geometries and predicted outputs are withheld. See task.md for the common scientific scope.
public_private_boundary: Identity/connectivity and declared measured observations are public. Author optimized new candidate geometries, computed rankings, reference outputs and legacy PASS archives are private.
